_meta.purpose: Retrieval eval set for M7 memory — 50 fact/query pairs scored as recall@5 (SDS 14.7, R-07).
_meta.written: before any retrieval code exists (deliberately, AVID-115) — so the queries are not shaped by what the implementation already answers.
_meta.voice: facts and queries are in the user's own voice — clipped, first-person, occasionally ambiguous — NOT database rows.

categories.direct: query shares content words with the fact — the easy centre
categories.proper_noun: query contains a name; vector search alone misses it (the 'Maya' case, SDS 7.7) — FTS5 keyword is why it works
categories.paraphrase: query shares NO content word with the fact — semantic-only
categories.temporal: 'what did i used to...', 'before i moved...' — the past
categories.negative: correct answer is NO fact matches (expect: null); includes plausible 'door slam' probes

_meta.scoring: positive: expect in returned[:k]. negative: returned == [] (retriever correctly surfaced nothing). Tracked over time, never gates CI.
